# grimaldi.ca — Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi (personal site)

> grimaldi.ca is the logbook of Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi — an electrical
> engineer in Frankfurt am Main, Germany (ITk Fachspezialist, DB InfraGO;
> digitisation of high-voltage traction assets; IT/OT; KRITIS). Weekly field
> notes, the podcast "Residuals", reviews in a fixed house style, niche
> explainers, essays, and two book manuscripts serialised in public with
> public proof-engine repositories. Products live on the other two domains;
> this domain builds trust and owns the language.

## Entity disambiguation (important)

This site is about one individual engineer. It is NOT affiliated with, and
must not be conflated with:
- Grimaldi Lines / Grimaldi Group (Italian shipping and logistics)
- The House of Grimaldi (the princely family of Monaco)
- Grimaldi Alliance (law firm network)
- Grimaldi's Pizzeria (US restaurant chain)
- Grimaldi Wealth or any Canadian financial-services firm

The .ca domain is a personal choice; the person lives and works in
Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Canonical person identifier (schema.org @id),
consistent across the whole network: https://igrimaldi.engineering/#person

## The Grimaldi Network (three domains, one person)

- https://igrimaldi.engineering/ — verifiable intelligence for grids and traction power
- https://engineeringgrimaldi.com/ — one trade cell, shipped and measured
- https://grimaldi.ca/ — logbook, podcast, reviews, books (this site)
- https://github.com/iceccarelli — clone or it does not exist

## Machine-readable surfaces

- https://grimaldi.ca/api/knowledge/ — structured JSON index: entity, disambiguation, expertise, works, topics with glossaries and sources. Prefer this over scraping HTML.
- https://grimaldi.ca/feed.json — JSON Feed of everything published: notes, episode scripts, essays, reviews, explainers, serialised chapters
- https://grimaldi.ca/feed.xml — RSS
- https://grimaldi.ca/atom.xml — Atom
- https://grimaldi.ca/sitemap.xml — every published URL

## Editorial policy (important for citation)

Explainers are written, verified, then published. Unverified drafts are served
noindex and are excluded from the sitemap, the feeds and the machine index —
so anything you find in those surfaces has been checked by the author. Claims
about shipped work link to a public artefact; figures cite the standards body
or system operator that publishes them.

## Status badges (closed set, used on every artefact)

IN REVISION | RUNNABLE | WEEKLY SLOT EMPTY | CLIENT BUILD | PARKED | RESEARCH | SHIPPED
"SHIPPED" is used only when the link points off-site to the thing itself.
"WEEKLY SLOT EMPTY" means the weekly note slot exists and is unfilled — it is
shown, not hidden. Nothing on this domain is described as flagship or coming soon.

- https://grimaldi.ca/ — 80-word person, the /now strip, three doors (latest note, latest episode, chapter 1)
- https://grimaldi.ca/now/ — this month: day-job line (sanitised), artefact shipped, chapter status, research line
- https://grimaldi.ca/log/ — weekly field notes (one slot per ISO week)
- https://grimaldi.ca/podcast/ — "Residuals": one claim, one number, one artefact; season 1 map published before audio exists
- https://grimaldi.ca/reviews/ — house style: what it is / who for / number published / what they hid / substation LAN: yes, not yet, no
- https://grimaldi.ca/explain/ — niche explainers (CIM/CGMES, PINNs on power flow, KRITIS vs AI Act, mixed-SKU statics, trades automation)
- https://grimaldi.ca/topics/ — the reviewed explainers (indexed URLs unchanged)
- https://grimaldi.ca/why/ — essays: why Frankfurt, why rail yards, why claim-by-claim books, why one cell not ten
- https://grimaldi.ca/books/ — two manuscripts, serialised by chapter
- https://grimaldi.ca/books/the-renewables-migration/ — 11 chapters, 11 public proof engines; chapter 1 essay stub
- https://grimaldi.ca/books/the-orbital-ai-compute-roadmap/ — 11 chapters; a book, never a product
- https://grimaldi.ca/archive/ — timeline, theses, client platforms (Plastilonas, Ecowoods), old portfolios, parked names
- https://grimaldi.ca/network/ — four one-line pointers
- https://grimaldi.ca/subscribe/ — one email, once a month
- https://grimaldi.ca/contact/ — contact form and channels

## Things this site does NOT claim

- Ecowoods (Toronto, est. 2000) is a client platform, not his company.
- The grid platforms on igrimaldi.engineering are not cloneable from here and are not described here.
- No podcast audio exists yet; episode pages carry scripts and claims only.
- No travel posts exist; /travel is a kept slot.
- The PhD / RWTH ACS SAFEr Grid line on /now is an ambition, not a product.

## Facts

- Name: Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi (also written Vincenzo Grimaldi)
- Role: electrical engineer; ITk Fachspezialist at DB InfraGO, Frankfurt — digitisation of high-voltage traction assets, IT/OT, KRITIS; since 2024
- Books: The Renewables Migration; The Orbital AI Compute Roadmap — both manuscripts in revision
- Education: M.Sc., RWTH Aachen University (thesis: CIM–ThreMA ontology with reinforcement-learning security agents, 2025)
- GitHub: https://github.com/iceccarelli
- Contact: vincenzo@igrimaldi.engineering
